hardware_profile.concurrency_constraint: RTX 3050 6GB VRAM cannot safely support simultaneous multi-model residency or heavy concurrent 8B LLM generation. Model execution lane must default to serial (concurrency=1).

q1_deterministic_tasks: Directory and folder hierarchy creation (create_folder, mkdir)
Standard boilerplate file scaffolding (HTML5 shell, CSS reset/variables, JS module skeleton, project metadata)
Read-only filesystem queries (read_file, list_directory, file_exists, git_status)
Level 0 (existence) and Level 1 (Python AST parse, JSON/HTML/CSS syntax) verification checks
Cryptographic hashing (SHA-256) and path boundary validation (workspace_manager.validate_path)
q2_llm_generation_required_tasks: Semantic application logic, complex business rules, dynamic algorithms
Creative layout and user-specified bespoke copywriting/copy-text
Refactoring, bug fixing, error diagnosis, and repair synthesis
Ambiguous natural-language planning and open-ended requirement interpretation
q3_boilerplate_repeatedly_generated: Standard HTML5 boilerplate (doctype, head, meta viewport/charset, link stylesheet, body container, script tags)
Standard CSS resets and variable setups (* { box-sizing: border-box; } :root { ... })
Standard JavaScript DOMContentLoaded wrappers and element selector scaffolding
In Prompt 5 EduPath Mini run, 719 HTML tokens + 753 CSS tokens included redundant structural boilerplate across 3 separate LLM turns
q4_serially_executed_independent_operati: MissionRunner executes tasks in a strict serial while-loop with 200ms sleep delays between tasks
Multi-file structural verifications in VerificationGate run in serial iteration
Independent non-model tasks (e.g. verifying independent files) are blocked serially
q5_safe_concurrent_operations: Deterministic template rendering with validated variables
Independent file writes targeting strictly distinct normalized paths (guarded by per-path locks)
Independent Level 1 structural verification (HTML parsing, CSS tokenization, JS/Python AST parsing)
CPU-only pre-processing, hash computation, and read-only static analysis
q6_shared_mutable_state_operations: TrajectoryMemory and SQLite memory store writes
Unified EventBus state and Mission terminal state transitions
Single physical GPU VRAM and Ollama server inference slot
q7_dependent_operations: Writing files inside a directory depends on parent directory creation
Level 0/Level 1 verification depends on successful file commit
Repair tasks depend on prior failed task execution and verifier diagnosis
Import analysis depends on target files existing on disk
q9_cpu_filesystem_operations: Filesystem staging, backup, commit, rollback, and cleanup (WriteFilesBatchTool)
AST parsing, regex matching, JSON validation, and SHA-256 calculation
q10_verification_and_index_refresh_trigg: Every file write tool (write_file, write_files_batch) triggers workspace_manager.refresh_index()
q11_potential_race_conditions: Concurrent writes to the exact same file path (prevented by Kairos file_locks)
Concurrent SQLite writes to hermes_workspace_index.db resulting in database is locked errors (prevented by single refresh barrier)
Concurrent LLM calls to Ollama causing VRAM exhaustion or latency spikes (prevented by gpu_semaphore(1))
Premature MISSION_COMPLETED event emission while asynchronous background workers are active
Mission cancellation racing against worker task completion
